title: Two Patterns in One
summary: Separate a mixed sequence into alternate terms.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: What are the next two numbers?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The numbers do not go up evenly.
Try splitting them into odd places and even places.
points: The numbers do not go up evenly.

steps.title: The method: Split the sequence
sentences: Take every first, third and fifth number: 2, 4, 6. That goes up by 2.
Take every second, fourth and sixth number: 10, 20, 30. That goes up by 10.
Two small patterns are mixed together.
points: Take every first, third and fifth number: 2, 4, 6. That goes up by 2.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The next first-line number is 8 and the next second-line number is 40.
When it looks messy, split it into two.
points: The next first-line number is 8 and the next second-line number is 40.

quiz.why: The two lines are 1,2,3 and 100,200,300, so 300 comes next.
